_comment: Official source register for lifecycle/. Every row published by this directory cites one of these
source IDs. A source is entered here only if the page was opened and read during this session
official-league        - published by the NFL (nfl.com, support.nfl.com, operations.nfl.com).
licensed-operator      - published by a licensed sportsbook (DraftKings). Primary authority for
market structure, odds arithmetic and settlement rules.
government-statistical - published by a government statistical authority (NIST). Methodological
reference for confidence limits and multiplicity control. It does not
project-state          - this repository's own committed artifacts. Used only to label a value
*recomputed* from a committed file; never an official publisher.
third-party-dataset    - a pinned open dataset (nflverse). Market numbers have no official
publication, so recomputed market values link here and are labelled Tier 3.
NO betting price, odds line, correlation coefficient, ROI figure or strategy result is invented here.
Recomputed values are deterministic functions of the committed files listed under project-state.

sources.title: DraftKings - Understanding Odds (KB0010466, v4.0, 2026-10-06)
sources.supports: American-odds arithmetic used by the price-snapshot store and the results feed: a -110 selection means wagering $110 to win a $100 profit; +110 means wagering $100 to win $110; the same price is 1.91x multiplier and 10/11 fractional. This is the arithmetic the break-even and ROI columns are built on.

sources.title: DraftKings Sportsbook - Bet Types and Market Rules
sources.supports: The three markets this project originates: 2-way point-spread markets (side), total-points markets settled Over/Under with a push when the total equals the line, and 2-way moneyline markets with a push on a tie. Also the push/void settlement rule that the verified results feed records per bet.

sources.title: What is a money line? - NFL Support
sources.read_note: IRREGULARITY F08 (re-confirmed live): this URL served the POINT-SPREAD article body, not the money-line body. The point-spread text served here defines a margin bet at -110 with a push on a whole-number line. The money-line definition is quoted from the point-spread URL below. Both readings are recorded rather than one being silently trusted.
sources.supports: The body served at this URL defines the point-spread market (margin of victory, -110, push on a whole-number line). Recorded because it is the text the money-line URL actually returned.

sources.title: What is the point spread? - NFL Support
sources.read_note: IRREGULARITY F08 (re-confirmed live): this URL served the MONEY-LINE article body, not the point-spread body. The money-line text served here defines a win-only wager, favourite with a minus sign, underdog with a plus sign, wager-to-win-$100, and a push on a tie.
sources.supports: The body served at this URL defines the moneyline market: bet on the winner only, favourite shown with a minus sign (wager to win $100), underdog with a plus sign, and a push if the game ties. Recorded because it is the text the point-spread URL actually returned.

sources.title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook - 7.2.2.2 Sample sizes required
sources.supports: The methodological basis for the demotion gate's sample-size trigger: a confidence interval's width depends on the sample size and the chosen confidence level, so a strategy with too few settled bets cannot support a live claim. Method reference only; it does not endorse any strategy.

sources.title: NIST/SEMATECH e-Handbook - 7.4.7 How can we make multiple comparisons?
sources.supports: The methodological basis for the demotion gate's multiplicity trigger: comparing many strategies at once inflates the chance of a false positive unless the family-wise error is controlled. Method reference only; it does not endorse any strategy.

sources.title: committed strategy ledger: data/derived/gates_results.csv
sources.supports: The committed per-strategy ledger (n, ROI, confidence bounds, p, BH q, seasons positive/tested, gates failed, tier) that the demotion gate and both leaderboards are recomputed from. Labelled *recomputed* wherever a value is derived from it.

sources.title: committed settled bet stream: data/derived/bets.csv
sources.supports: The committed settled bet stream (strategy, market, side, line, price, edge, outcome, pnl) that the verified results feed summarizes. Labelled *recomputed* wherever a value is derived from it.

sources.title: nflverse/nfldata @ a270278 (pinned commit)
sources.supports: The pinned, checksummed open dataset behind the committed ledgers. The NFL publishes no machine-readable lines, so no line value here is an NFL official publication; market numbers are Tier 3 and labelled *recomputed* from this pinned commit.
